derivation.left_pelvis: h36m hip half-width scaled by winter thigh / h36m thigh
derivation.right_pelvis: h36m hip half-width scaled by winter thigh / h36m thigh
derivation.head: neck to nose in the neutral head model (winter eye level, mediapipe nose offset)
derivation.left_eye_link: nose to eye centre: ansur2 interpupillary breadth, mediapipe offsets
derivation.right_eye_link: nose to eye centre: ansur2 interpupillary breadth, mediapipe offsets
derivation.left_ear_link: eye centre to ear: ansur2 head breadth and tragion height, ear over neck (kendall)
derivation.right_ear_link: eye centre to ear: ansur2 head breadth and tragion height, ear over neck (kendall)

sources.winter: Winter DA. Biomechanics and Motor Control of Human Movement, 4th ed. Wiley, 2009, Fig. 4.1 (after Drillis and Contini 1966)
sources.ansur2: Gordon CC et al. 2012 Anthropometric Survey of US Army Personnel (ANSUR II), public data, NATICK/TR-15/007; pooled 4,082 men and 1,986 women
sources.h36m: Human3.6M skeleton offsets (Ionescu et al. 2014) as published in facebookresearch/QuaterNet short_term/dataset_h36m.py
sources.kendall: Kendall FP et al. Muscles: Testing and Function with Posture and Pain, 5th ed. 2005: ideal plumb line through the ear lobe and the acromion
